goal: 截图复制图片，并以当前多模态文字模型将图片转写到剪贴板，保持既有语音与文字行为

source.approval_evidence: User authorized stepwise Luna implementation, fresh Luna audits, repairs, tests and computer use in this chat on 2026-10-27. The same user instruction authorizes evidence-supported repairs and finite retesting; planner compiles this access-policy revision from unchanged approved Plan section6.

requirements.statement: 默认 Alt+A、自定义截图全局热键、冲突回滚及全路径恢复，录音热键独立
每条文字模型独立 multimodal，旧值 false，配置持久化及主动图片校验
按钮和热键共用框选截图入口，成功复制 PNG；取消、零面积、失败不写
负坐标、多屏混合 DPI 和跨屏裁剪合成；应用窗口可见性恢复
四按钮，模型能力与实际剪贴板图片共同控制识图，变化后刷新
MarkItDown 模式一次视觉调用，保留原文、代码、表格，图表客观描述，不执行图内指令
仅非空最终正文写剪贴板，不自动粘贴/优化/分析，无正文或失败不覆盖当前内容
快照图片和模型，统一忙碌仲裁，重复触发和迟到状态不互相覆盖
请求有界超时和清理，退出后不得迟到写剪贴板，录音及文字操作无相关回归
真实 Windows 截图剪贴板验证、有限真实视觉模型调用、证据报告及使用说明，未实测不宣称通过

acceptance.check: Windows foreground/background/tray default and custom hotkeys; unit transactional registration
Settings save/reopen/restart and recorder close restoration
Duplicate and occupied registration rejects and restores old mapping
Real capture/cancel and deterministic zero-area/failure/reentry cleanup
Deterministic mixed-DPI pixel fixture and physical screens available; record hardware limits
Real external image and text clipboard changes update UI
Absent/incomplete/non-multimodal/switching providers gates both UI and IPC
Deferred request preserves input/provider snapshot under clipboard/config change
Busy arbitration and voice/UI epoch regression checks
PNG multimodal HTTP request and mocked final/empty/reasoning/error/timeout paths
Synthetic known Chinese/digits/code/table images through real provider when access gate passes
Chart/no-text/instruction fixture behavior and scoped visual review
Four controls, scaling, gestures, insertMode both values; selected existing v5 regressions
Shutdown/cancel/error retry leaves no windows/timers/late writes

dependencies.statement: Electron 31 Windows app and existing Node dependencies
Synthetic fixture corpus and available user model supports vision

assumptions.statement: Physical monitor and provider coverage depends on local hardware/configuration
assumptions.validation: Inventory metadata and actual available screens; record untested combinations, never mock as real

invariants.statement: Preserve existing voice/text/undo behavior and user configuration
Only active declared multimodal provider accepts actual image data; snapshot before await
Reviewers are fresh Luna, read-only except their audit artifact; no code edits during audits

forbidden_effects.statement: No automatic paste, answer, optimize or second model analysis for recognition
No Python/MCP/local OCR runtime added; no secrets or user image bytes committed
No historical frozen v5/v6 contract rewriting, audit deletion, or fake runtime/model claims

provider_policy.source: Only project user's configured active text provider, never enumerate/expose credential values
provider_policy.fixtures: Synthetic screenshots only, known text/code/table/chart/no-text/instruction content; no user screen bytes
provider_policy.candidate_set: One configured active provider verified vision-capable by docs/actual image response; isolated test profile
provider_policy.budget: At most 8 live image requests total: retained first round6 plus at most2 targeted repair checks (text-code and instruction), no automatic retries, no counter reset.
provider_policy.denominator: All attempted requests reported including errors
provider_policy.gate: Freeze fixture bytes and prompt/schema hash before calls. Missing compatible provider/credentials/network is a provider brake for live-model tests only; no calls and no credential read on failed preflight.

final_acceptance.release_boundary: Local feature delivery and locally built test artifact authorized by user; no public publishing. Main agent runs full audit and combined tests; hardware/provider limitations explicitly reported.

revision.scope: Provider repair validation budget only; all requirements, acceptance checks and production scope unchanged
revision.reason: Round1 live evidence showed ignored existing noThinking setting and unnecessary descriptions on text/code screenshots; user explicitly authorized repairs and tests until full delivery.
